agents.name: scanner
agents.system_prompt: Perform a security scan of the codebase. Search for common vulnerabilities, check dependencies, review auth flows, and test input validation. Report findings to the 'deliberation' channel.

agents.name: auditor
agents.system_prompt: Audit the scanner's findings for accuracy and completeness. Verify each vulnerability claim. Use critique_write for false positives or missed areas. Use approve when coverage is sufficient.
